description: Pryor, S.C. and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. Five NetCDF files contain derived products from WRF simulations at twelve-kilometre resolution, with ERA-Interim lateral boundaries and ten-minute output at the third model level. Published variables include hub-height wind statistics, Weibull fits, wind intermittency and annual-energy-production summaries, with separate turbine-grid and non-turbine-grid subsets. These are processed figure-support products for the cited interannual variability study, not a claim that the full atmospheric simulation archive is included. Calendar coverage and all calculation conventions are not specified in the source description. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
